bends.reason: Leg-root ~90 deg bend (one of four legs). Section: scan lies on the blue profile along both arms (leg plus its end hook, base, and the parallel opposite leg); no points along the orange flat continuation. Raw iso, front and side views show all four legs standing perpendicular to the base on the same side.

Hook fold-back (~125 deg) at a leg end. Section: scan turns sharply back down-left like the blue profile, offset ~2 mm and slightly less acute (~115 deg vs ~125 deg). Nothing continues along the orange flat direction. Raw side view shows fully curled hooks on both sides with no straight continuation.
First hook bend (~60 deg) at a leg end. Section: scan follows the blue profile along the leg, the angled hook segment and its return, and the opposite leg's hook; no points along orange.
Leg-root ~90 deg bend. The section has the same form as B1: scan on the blue leg, base and opposite leg; no orange-side points. The legs are visibly upright in the raw global views.
Hook fold-back. Section: scan folds back down-left, with a sparser return segment offset ~2 mm from blue; it does not run along the orange flat direction. The raw side view hooks are fully curled.
First hook bend (~60 deg). Section: scan follows the blue leg, the angled hook segment and the return leg closely; no orange-side points.
Leg-root ~90 deg bend. Section: scan on the blue profile for the leg, its hook, the base and the opposite leg; no orange-side points.

Joggle bend (riser to offset lip). Section: scan follows the blue Z, with the lip parallel to the base and offset ~18 mm. Raw front view shows the Z-tab (riser ~17 mm, lip ~42 mm), and the raw top view shows the lip lying inside its window.
Joggle bend (base to riser). Section: scan follows the blue riser and offset lip, and the base segments on both sides lie on blue; no orange-side points. The Z-tab is formed in the raw front view.
First hook bend (~60 deg). Section: scan follows the blue leg, hook segment and return; the opposite-leg hook is within ~1-2 mm. No orange-side points.
Hook fold-back. Section: scan nearly coincides with the blue fold-back (apex and return leg within ~1 mm); nothing along orange.
Leg-root ~90 deg bend. Section: scan on the blue leg, base and opposite leg; the hook tip is within ~1-2 mm. No orange-side points.
First hook bend (~60 deg). Section: scan follows the blue leg, hook segment and return closely; no orange-side points.
Hook fold-back. Section: scan folds back down-left, offset ~2 mm and slightly less acute than blue; it does not follow the orange flat continuation. The raw side view shows complete hooks.

Mid flange at a window edge, ~90 deg. Section: scan follows the blue flange perpendicular to the base; at the section location it is ~13 mm, matching the CAD there. Raw front and top views show a ~37 mm flange standing perpendicular across the full width.

End lip, ~90 deg. Section: scan lies on the blue ~35 mm flange and the base; no orange-side points. Raw front, top and iso views show the lip standing up at the end next to the legs, on the same side as all the other flanges.
